_comment: Locked topic definitions + keyword pre-filter lists for the state-media pipeline. NO SENTIMENT. Topics are the ONLY allowed tags; an item may carry multiple. classify.py uses keyword_prefilter to decide which items survive to (optional) API tagging, and --offline mode uses these keyword lists alone. Edit deliberately: changing definitions changes historical comparability.

topic_definitions.climate: Coverage of climate change, greenhouse-gas emissions, extreme weather attributed to climate, drought/wildfire/flood risk framed as climate, renewable vs. fossil energy transition, and climate science or adaptation. NOT routine weather forecasts.
topic_definitions.politics: Coverage of elections, campaigns, candidates, legislatures, governors, ballot measures, partisan conflict, redistricting, voting/election administration, and government appointments. General statehouse politics not tied to a specific bill's substance.
topic_definitions.economic_development: Coverage of jobs, business investment, plant openings/closings, incentives and tax credits for employers, infrastructure spending framed as growth, housing supply, workforce, and industry expansion. The MONEY-AND-JOBS lens.
topic_definitions.environmental_legislation: Coverage of specific bills, regulations, rules, permits, or legal actions concerning the environment: pollution limits, water quality, land use, conservation mandates, EPA/state-agency rulemaking, and environmental litigation. The distinction from 'climate' is that this tag requires a concrete legislative/regulatory/legal instrument.

keyword_prefilter._comment: Case-insensitive substring/word matching. An item passes the pre-filter (and is eligible for tagging) if it matches ANY keyword in ANY topic. In --offline mode, the topic(s) whose lists matched become the item's tags directly.

entity_extraction._comment: Entities are countable facts (who/what was mentioned), NOT judgments. Offline mode uses a lightweight regex + known-entity gazetteer; API mode asks Claude to list proper-noun entities. Types are hints only.
